message:
Fixed. "Crème brûlée recipes" now becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`, and `npm test` passes all 3 tests.

The change is one line in `src/blog/slug.js`. Before slugifying, it decomposes accented characters (NFD) and strips the combining marks, so "è" becomes "e" and "û" becomes "u". I left the vendored `vendor/slugify/index.js` alone because its header says not to edit it by hand.

`src/shop/product-url.js` also uses the vendored slugify, so it likely has the same accent-dropping behavior. I didn't change it since you asked about blog URLs. I haven't committed anything.
